summary: Pole tower built in the 1930s on a 3,465-ft peak east of Cle Elum; register says it is gone. Landowner issues and communication towers nearby.

facts.status_note: The register lists the pole tower as gone. None of the cited sources describes what remains of it on the summit.

access.note: Willhite reports possible landowner issues, land for sale and trespass signs. Check access before visiting.

notes_for_editor: Name clash: the Kittitas County Lookout Mountain (US 1370, 6,198 ft, 11 miles southwest of Cle Elum) is a different site. The Willhite page cited here has a 3,465-ft summit, which matches US 1413; it is the Wenatchee NF site. The 1930s date is a decade only, so no built event is recorded. Access 'restricted' is inferred from Willhite's landowner, for-sale and trespass notes; no source confirms who owns the land. The Willhite page contains route text, which was deliberately left out. Record check: coordinates and elevation match the register; no corrections proposed. No photos added.
